player_prompt.intro: Wena ungumdlali {player_id} ku-Wild Tic Tac Toe. Ngesikhathi sakho, ungafaka i-'X' noma i-'O' esikhaleni esingenalutho. Uwina ngokuqondanisa izimpawu ezintathu ezifanayo (X noma O) ngokulandelana. Unganqoba nganoma yisiphi isibonisi. Khetha isinyathelo sakho usebenzisa ifomethi '[X 4]' ukubeka i-X maphakathi.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ifomethi yokunyakaza engalungile. Sebenzisa ifomethi ethi "[X 4]" noma "[O 2]".
invalid_move.invalid_cell: Inombolo yekheli engekho emthethweni: {cell}. Kumele ibe phakathi kuka-0 no-8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Ukuhamba okungekho emthethweni. Iseli {cell} selivele lihlala.
